notes: Feasibility = EngiBench constraints plus the volfrac budget. Latent instrument is pinned on measured reconstruction parity, not on nominal threshold satisfaction: bbec6c0a (performance constraint ON) reaches NMSE 0.00214 and its companion 36c3f928 (constraint OFF) reaches 0.00218 -- matched to within 2% at 6 active dimensions each, which is what makes lv_dual_gap isolate the constraint's effect. bbec6c0a nominally misses its own 0.001 threshold, but that threshold is below this architecture's achievable floor of ~0.00146, so no configuration in the sweep met it.
